comparison.objective: Release a spring clamp and recover a retained screwdriver; candidate assembles a collet into a nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a compliant lever while retaining and transferring a tool versus align a groove, tilt/roll, and snap into an eccentric lip.
comparison.success_condition: Tool clears the jaw and finishes in a verified left-gripper pinch without drop/base motion versus hands-free collet retention and withdrawal resistance.
comparison.reason: Release/recovery is mechanically opposite to assembly/retention; generic force control does not establish overlap.
